1.  Recommendation to conduct second reading of Ordinance No. 2023­613, adding Chapter 5.97 to
  Title 5 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, imposing regulations on Mobile Food Vending.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, provided the staff report.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

2.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 038­2023, which (1) Approves an Amendment to the
  City of Hawaiian Gardens Flexible Benefit Plan;
  (2) Adopts the City of Hawaiian Gardens Health Reimbursement Arrangement;
  (3) Approves the retention of MidAmerica Administrative & Retirement Solutions, LLC
  (“MidAmerica”) to provide administrative services in connection with the Retiree HRA; and,
  (4) Authorizes the City Manager, or his designee, to duly execute the amended and restated
  adoption agreement to the Plan, the Retiree HRA, and any documents necessary to retain
  MidAmerica to provide administrative services in connection with the Retiree HRA.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, spoke.

D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, thanked Recreation staff for their hard
work; announced that the Annual Tree Lighting Event will be held December 1, 2023, Breakfast with
Santa will be held on December 9, 2023.

Councilmember Roa spoke.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on the Pioneer Park Renovation Project,
playground equipment will be shipped to the city in December; and that a block clean­up program will be
held Saturday, November 18, 2023 (depending on weather).

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember De Paula announced that he attended the Teen Center Haunted Maze.

Mayor Del Rio thanked staff who participated in the recent City events; and thanked veterans.
